title: Recuperative Care Service Prior Authorization now available
supports: DHS requires prior authorization for all recuperative care services effective 2026-08-01.
Providers must use DHS-8900 for services on or after the effective date, replacing the prior 21-day extended-stay process.
does_not_support: The prior-authorization requirement is a control change and is not evidence that recuperative-care providers committed fraud.
The notice does not provide a fraud, improper-payment, or recovery amount.
